title: Formulary Benefit Line-up: Structure, Tier Count and Sponsor Election
content:
The Formulary Benefit is offered by Northbridge Rx in six formularies. Each one is elected by the plan sponsor for all of its members, and each carries an entry gate, a structure, a number of member cost-share tiers and a drug list update cycle.

## Schedule of formularies

| Formulary | Elected by the sponsor | Plan designs admitted | Minimum enrolled lives | Structure | Cost-share tiers | Drug list update cycle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Exclusive Formulary | yes | HDHP with HSA; deductible with copay | 2 | closed | 4 | quarterly |
| Northbridge Value Formulary | yes | HDHP with HSA; deductible with copay; copay only | 2 | closed | 4 | quarterly |
| Northbridge Standard Formulary | yes | HDHP with HSA; deductible with copay; copay only | 2 | closed | 5 | quarterly |
| Northbridge Preferred Drug List | yes | HDHP with HSA; deductible with copay; copay only | 51 | closed | 5 | quarterly |
| Northbridge Broad Formulary | yes | deductible with copay; copay only | 101 | open | 5 | semiannual |
| Northbridge Open Formulary | yes | copay only | 501 | open | 5 | semiannual |

## Meaning of the columns

- **Structure.** On a *closed* formulary a drug coded NF is not covered unless a formulary exception is approved; without one the member pays the pharmacy's discounted cash price. On an *open* formulary a drug that is not on the list is covered without an exception, at the cost-share tier at which an approved non-formulary exception covers a non-specialty drug.
- **Cost-share tiers.** A count of 4 means tiers 1 through 4, with a single specialty tier. A count of 5 means tiers 1 through 5.
- **Update cycle.** The drug list is updated on this cycle after review by the Pharmacy & Therapeutics committee.

## Points of reading

*Can a sponsor with a copay-only plan design elect the Northbridge Exclusive Formulary?* No. That formulary admits only the HDHP with HSA and the deductible with copay designs.

*Hypothetical election check.* Take a sponsor with 120 enrolled lives on a copay-only design. It meets the entry gate of the Value, Standard, Preferred Drug List and Broad formularies (minimums of 2, 2, 51 and 101 lives). It does not meet the gate of the Northbridge Open Formulary, which needs 501 lives, or of the Northbridge Exclusive Formulary, which does not admit the copay-only design.
